question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**stranger**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, the subject is referred as stranger in line 2 as well.
 
• ** In this context, the blank space is asking us to fill in the occupation or identity of a person, and "stranger" is the most appropriate option as we do not know who this person is.**
 
 
• The word "stranger" refers to someone who is not known or familiar to us.(अजनबी)
 
 
• ​Example: The stranger asked me to show him the way to the shopping mall.
 
 
 
• It is a noun and can be used to describe someone we have never met before.
 
 

​​Hence, **the correct answer is option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (friend) refers to someone we know and have a positive relationship with.(दोस्त)
 
• Option 2 (sage) refers to a wise or knowledgeable person, often used in a religious or spiritual context.(ऋषि)
 
• Option 3 (businessman) refers to someone who is involved in commerce or trade.(व्यापारी)
